solutions.explanation:
Every real power of \(1\) equals \(1\), so the numerator does not depend on \(y\). Raising a nonzero number to the exponent \(-1\) gives its reciprocal. Therefore the denominator is
\[
5^{-1}+3^{-1}
=\frac15+\frac13
=\frac3{15}+\frac5{15}
=\frac8{15}.
\]
This denominator is nonzero. Dividing by a fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal, so
\[
\frac{1^{4y-1}}{5^{-1}+3^{-1}}
=1\div\frac8{15}
=\frac{15}{8}.
\]
The value is \(\boxed{15/8}\), choice D.
